{{Top|leg}}
'''"Waaatto!"''' was a song about [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] former master. It was played by a [[Unidentified young new recruit|precocious Jedi recruit]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It featured in a songbook specifically created to remind Skywalker of his home planet after he became a [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]].
